ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fruits of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Waqi'ah underscores the concept of 'Kathir' (abundance) not merely in quantity but in quality and variety, reflecting the divine generosity towards the Muttaqin. It serves as a tangible sign of the spiritual purity attained through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings, where earthly fruits are elevated to eternal, imperishable delights.
